title: Great but misses a few things
body:
I love the concept and it proves to be effective as well but this does not have any instant gratification techniques and to unlock any new tree it takes tremendous amount of effort and the achievements are also rather small. so by that point your interest wears off, that leaves you with very limited options to earn coins and not a lot of people would like to spend money to buy coins after having paid for the app itself.

At times when you want to take a break, you can’t pause the timer so I used to keep the timer on while I did something else just so that I don’t have a dead plant In my garden.

In iOS devices it lacks the feature of locking the screen to that particular application even in deep focus mode, rather it gives a 5 second span to return or it kills the tree- and the 5 seconds are not very foolproof.

As a result of this didn’t find myself addicted to it like other games and social media apps. At the end i found myself depending on my sense of responsibility to be focused rather than the app.

To improve they could adapt the format of games like Call of duty where you have a level that increases with the xp that you earn and you can earn xp from growing trees. You could also have rewards for leveling up and for achievements there can be daily tasks and a general achievement list that changes with every level that you cross. The leadboard should be enhanced with planters in different leagues like silver and platinum, etc. if the option of building like a santuary is provided which will act like the bases in Clash of clan it could be great and the option of having something similar to clans will be amazing. And to top all of that the addition of animals in these forest would be TOO good, like some different animals will be available after you have a certain amount of trees and different species of animals live in different types of habitats. There could be savanna, Amazon, underwater, swamp, park, etc. 
These changes would truly motivate planters to come back everyday by building a positive dopamine release addiction.

I track it manually and yes I have a digital record in forest app. I follow The Now Habit guideline for getting rid of Procrastinating habit which is not let me play guilt free nor enjoy the flow of deep work. Forest App provide focusing music which helps me going in flow easily. I hope one day I will use this app for continuously working for 3 hours without distractions. That will be an awesome feeling.

title: A synonym for wonderful.
body:
It is an absolute time saver. When you open the app, and set it to grow a tree or bush for the next...I don't know, 1 hour? 2 hours? You're essentially buying quality time for yourself and your work. 

I find myself using forest more and more. It helps to keep me in the moment. So many times I have found myself opening the screen of my phone only to find a tree growing, the app telling me to get back to work. 
It's wonderful. Everyone needs this in their life.
